correctness.rationale: The graph spectrum is 0,1,m+1,rm+1 with the claimed multiplicities. Explicit orthogonal projectors give L^+ and L^{+2}. Splitting the two-leader pinning into sum and difference vectors, eliminating the constant mode, and applying Sherman--Morrison yields an exact inverse-trace formula. Substitution gives all three rational values; B-A has strictly positive factors and C-A has a polynomial numerator negative at r=2 but positive for r>=3, including m=2 via discriminant -135. The accompanying exact-rational program passed 1566 checks. All ranges and strictness are covered analytically; finite checks alone are not treated as proof.

value.rationale: Two finite-gain leaders on hub-cluster networks are a motivated design question. The exact all-gain phase jump when the number of clique blades changes from two to three is a genuine structural classification, not merely a routine numerical example: in the two-blade case the globally highest-degree hub is strictly excluded, while for all r>=3 it is strictly mandatory. Strict absence of ties and closed achieved performance hold on an unbounded two-parameter graph family. The result does not claim a universal principle beyond this topology and gain model.
